title: Why Do Cats' Paws Smell Like Catnip?

scenes.text: Ever notice a cat's paws smell oddly sweet?
People think cats store catnip in their paws.
scenes.label: Paws store catnip

scenes.text: The scent comes from natural oils and the sebaceous glands on their foot pads, which can resemble the volatile compounds in catnip.
scenes.label: Oil glands cause scent
scenes.query: cat foot pad sebaceous glands odor
